hooks.command: TOOL_INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(Dockerfile|compose\.yaml|compose\.override|compose\.production|\.env\.example|entrypoint|php\.ini|nginx\.conf)'; then echo '[Hook] Config file changed. Remember: make build && make down && make up'; fi
TOOL_INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '\.claude/commands/.*\.md'; then echo '[Hook] Claude command updated. Sync to other AI tools with: make ai-commands-sync FROM=claude'; fi
TOOL_INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(\.rulesync/.*\.md|CLAUDE\.md)'; then echo '[Hook] AI rules updated. Sync to all tools with: make ai-rules-sync'; fi
TOOL_INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'make composer CMD="?(require|remove)'; then echo '[Hook] PHP package changed. Run: make composer-install-local'; fi
TOOL_INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'make pnpm CMD="?(add|remove)'; then echo '[Hook] Node package changed. Run: make pnpm-install-local'; fi
